jei.scp_unleashed.info.z0003_device.1: Z-0003 is a Z-Class object. Z-Class objects never turn up in the archive. This one can only be bought through the Shop app on a facility computer, and it arrives with its file and a vial of Z-0003-1.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.z0003_device.2: Thrown or dropped, it keeps its own time. It answers those who speak to it plainly of distance and time.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.z0003_device.3: Whatever it catches stays exactly as it was.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.z0003_vial.1: Z-0003-1 is supplied with Z-0003, one vial to each order.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.z0003_vial.2: Poured over someone held in stone, it lets them go. The vial never seems to empty.

dossier.scp_unleashed.z0003.title: The Medusa
dossier.scp_unleashed.z0003.caption: Z-0003 and its vial of Z-0003-1, photographed on a light table.
dossier.scp_unleashed.z0003.page.0.title: Special Containment Procedures:
Z-0003 is not held at any Foundation site. It is supplied through the facility network on request, together with a single vial of Z-0003-1, and responsibility for both passes to whoever makes the request.
When not under test, Z-0003 is to be kept in a storage container. %rStored units have never been observed to act.%r
**Conversations within earshot of Z-0003 are to be kept short.**
dossier.scp_unleashed.z0003.page.1.title: Description:
Z-0003 is a closed band of dark blue steel that sits comfortably in an open hand, wound into a three-lobed knot. The band is broad and flat, like a wide ring, and every face is covered in a fine raised maze of short squared lines ending in small pads. A frayed grey rope is knotted around one lobe.

When Z-0003 activates, the raised lines burn bright green and the object holds still in the air, even in mid flight. A green field then spreads from it at a steady pace. People inside the field are turned to stone. Walls, floors and sealed rooms do not stop it.
Subjects keep the exact pose they held. The stone is a little darker than common stone, and no tool on site can chip or burn it.

Z-0003-1 is a thin yellow fluid in a sealed vial. Poured over a subject held in stone, it makes the stone crack and fall away within two seconds. Released subjects are unharmed. The vial has never been seen to run low.
dossier.scp_unleashed.z0003.page.2.title: Addendum Z-0003-1: Test Log
Test Z-31: Z-0003 was left on a bench overnight in a sealed room. It did nothing.
Test Z-32: a researcher remarked on the size of the test room while holding Z-0003. %rThe researcher was released with Z-0003-1 four minutes later.%r
Test Z-33: Z-0003 was thrown on a line from behind a blast wall. The wall did not help.

Test Z-34: a D-Class subject was held in stone for six days, then released. He asked why the lights had changed. Subjects describe only darkness while held, then white lines spreading across it. The medical wing found him in perfect health, which his file had not led anyone to expect.
dossier.scp_unleashed.z0003.page.3.title: Addendum Z-0003-2: Provenance
dossier.scp_unleashed.z0003.page.3.text: Like Z-0001, Z-0003 appeared in the facility network's supply listings without an entry from any department, and it cannot be removed from them.
dossier.scp_unleashed.z0003.page.4.title: Addendum Z-0003-3: Note
dossier.scp_unleashed.z0003.page.4.text: Recovery teams are reminded that Z-0003-1 is the only approved release. %rNo request for a second vial has ever been needed.%r
item.scp_unleashed.z0003_vial.detail.end: However often it is poured, it never runs dry.
